To the "It's too expensive" remark:
1. Ask why and listen to rational (try to come back to core issue) 
2. Check value is understood (with focus on solving the core issue): "What value would our offering created last year if you had it?" [nb: if our offering is not creating value, sometimes better to stop the process]

3. Co-construct by proposing to withdraw some elements (enables to focus on what is really important) or to get more from the client (ex. testimonials): there must have a "price" for the client if we reduce the price
